name: cm_secret_update
description: Update Kubernetes ConfigMap and Secret YAML resources.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: Execution mode: 'folder' (source and target directories) or 'deployments' (configmaps and secrets from release context).

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Directory of ConfigMap/Secret update definitions; required in folder mode.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: Directory of target ConfigMap/Secret YAML files, created when missing; required in folder mode.

arguments.name: configmaps
arguments.description: ConfigMap resources from release context (kind, name, source, repository, optional operations); used in deployments mode.

arguments.name: secrets
arguments.description: Secret resources from release context (kind, name, source, repository, optional operations); used in deployments mode.

arguments.name: replace
arguments.description: Replace the data of existing targets instead of merging into them.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Whether every resource was updated without errors.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Errors per resource (kind, name, path, message).
